title: X Content Plan
description: One theme expanded into the angles it genuinely supports. The planning unit of A10-X: a theme is never drafted directly into a single post. A theme whose available_basis is empty is not scheduled — it becomes a request to the practitioner or to Research Agent (responsibilities.md section A).

theme_source.description: Priority order in responsibilities.md section A. client_question outranks every keyword source — it is the literal language of people who already paid.

source_detail.description: For client_question, the question in the client's own words.

available_basis.description: What can actually be supplied TODAY, not what could be obtained in principle. An empty set means the theme is not schedulable.

target_reader.description: Who this theme is for and what situation they are in.

entry_point.description: The different door this angle opens. Two angles that would produce near-identical bodies mean one was not a real angle — drop it (responsibilities.md section B).

angles.description: A theme supporting only one angle is a weak theme and is deprioritised.

verification_load.description: positioning.md section 6: X-B and X-C throughput is bounded by fact-checking, not by writing. Batch planning is done against this, not against drafting speed.

lead_time_days.description: Includes fact-check turnaround, which is the long pole for categories A and D.

repurpose_value.description: Whether this theme can also feed an article or an Ameba post.

status.description: 'approved' normally comes from A07 Content Strategy Agent. Until A07 exists, a human approves it (workflow.md section Interim operation).

then.description: A history theme with no verifiable-fact basis available is not schedulable.
